config.name: junctionx-2026
config.weight_derivation: Weights are score weights over per-track accuracies (plan section 6, open decision O2: 50/25/25 proposed, settled by the #25 pilot). They are not item-count shares: a track's weight says how much its accuracy counts, not how many items it runs. The counts below follow the per-track bands of plan section 4 instead, and the set manifest records weights and resulting counts side by side so the two cannot silently disagree.
